DATA, never code: scripts/seed-pm-criteria.ts loads it into pm_criteria ONCE per shop (dry run by default; --apply only on Juan's word, CC runs it on sim first), after Task 14b's BOH positions exist; managers then edit it in the Tier E criteria editor. A position entry matches a station_positions row of the shop by its EXACT name (station: null = whichever station holds it; more than one match, or none, is a refusal — never a guess).
